# roadie_data_source (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Roadie data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "roadie_data_source" "existing" {
  id = "data-source-uuid-here"
}

output "data_source_enabled" {
  value = data.roadie_data_source.existing.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the data source.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `edges` (String) The data source edges as JSON. UI-only fields are stripped.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `nodes` (String) The data source nodes as JSON. UI-only fields are stripped.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `version` (Number)
- `workflow_type` (String)
